name: agent-routing
description: Synthetic user tasks mapped to a fixed capability set.
methodology: Hand-authored tasks: at least one per route, several deliberately ambiguous or low-confidence cases (garbled input, overlapping capabilities), and one consequential/irreversible action routed to a human on policy grounds rather than task-shape. Labels encode the author's routing policy, not a ground truth about the tasks themselves. Not sampled from real usage -- do not reuse these labels outside this example.
